app.name: ScummVM (RPX test)
app.coder: ScummVM Team; Wii U port by Rrhapsod
app.short_description: Wii Remote IR candidate: button 2 = Escape
app.long_description: Native Wii U SDL2 port with Wii Remote IR mouse input and simultaneous GamePad controls. Button 2 shares GamePad Y (Escape/back); Nunchuk C shares GamePad R (slow analog pointer). I reported success with the preceding Remote build; this remapping and new r51 SDK build still need my console check. Experimental RPX: non-Aroma loaders remain unverified. See TESTING.md. No games, saves, configuration or MT-32 ROMs are included.
